title: Sorry, moon
old_caption:
Libra drafted a moon poll at 1 AM, deleted it, and said the sweet thing instead. The moon took the news well.
Have you ever blamed the moon for a feeling?

title: Say it at noon
old_caption:
Scorpio, hood up, deletes two drafts and then just says it. The reply asks for a repeat in daylight.
Would you say it again at noon?

title: In This House: Cancer's rules
old_caption: Cancer will send you home with five tubs of soup and then text "home safe" from the mailbox. Twelve steps. Which rule does your house have?

title: In This House: an Aries and Virgo home
old_caption: Aries wins every race to the door, then holds it open anyway. Virgo labels the chaos. And every fight starts with snacks. Who in your house runs the label maker?

title: In This House: Aquarius rules
old_caption: The robot arm hands you the remote, Thursday is rock collection night, and "I love you" no longer comes in binary. What's the weirdest rule you'd keep?

title: In This House: Capricorn's calendar
old_caption: Every square of the week is planned except one, circled twice: NOTHING. Capricorn in striped socks, resting on purpose. Tag the friend who needs that square.

title: In This House: Libra says no
old_caption: Teal or plum? They talked it out. The chipped mug is the favourite. And a fourth weekend plan got a kind, clear "not this time." Proud of you, Libra.

title: Plot Twist: the late date
old_caption: Twenty minutes late, three drafts deleted, one map with three pins. Meanwhile they were outside the door practising hello. Which sign rehearses their entrance?

title: Plot Twist: the hummed tune
old_caption: You hum one tune on date one, they go quiet, then it's "busy!" for three days. Turns out they were learning to play it. One note wrong, every bit of heart.

title: Plot Twist: Friday got cancelled
old_caption: "can't do friday, sorry" and Cancer's spiral reaches the soup by Tuesday. Then the next text: Saturday, blanket fort, no alarms. Be honest, how fast do you spiral?
